name: Kona Chess Club
notes: The Kona Chess Club represents the community of Kona. You may join if you are a resident of Kona or are visiting Kona to play in FIDE and USCF rated chess tournaments. NO CHEATING will be TOLERATED. No chess engines can be used during any rated chess games. NO NEGATIVE OR DEROGATORY COMMENTS are allowed to be posted anywhere. NO SPAM. If you play in team matches, NO RESIGNING when the going gets rough. Also NO DRAWS because you are tired of playing. In chess, you play to WIN. Kona Chess Club meets Tuesday's 6-8P at the Kona Library. First hour is chess lesson. Last hour is free play. Meet other chess players. Bring your chess set.

name: Seven Cities
notes: This is an online club for chess.com players in the Hampton Roads, Virginia metro area. Our purpose is to develop a network of local area players who enjoy competitive play and would be interested in gathering not only for online events, but for over-the-board (OTB) events in the Hampton Roads area. Membership is not restricted by rating or geographical location, but we do intend to extend our online play to OTB challenges at local area meeting places. If we achieve adequate organization and participation, we will explore League play and the possibility of holding a USCF-sanctioned OTB Tournament.

name: Seguin Public Library Chess Club
notes: The Seguin Public Library holds 2 chess events per month, providing patrons with an opportunity to learn and play chess in an informal setting. Chess boards and chess clocks are provided during each event. Both events are listed below: Chess Junior: For ages 6-11 of all skill levels. Chess Junior is held in the story hour room at the Seguin Public Library every first Wednesday of the month. All Ages Chess Club: Patrons of any age and any skill level are welcome to attend this informal chess club! All Ages Chess is held in the community meeting room at the Seguin Public Library every 4th Thursday of the month. The Seguin Public Library hopes to spread the love of chess with these 2 clubs and aims to continue spreading the enjoyment of chess to all in the community!

name: Kauai Chess Club
notes: Kauai Chess Club is a place to meet fellow chess players on the beautiful island of Kauai in the Hawaiian Archipelago. We have regular USCF-rated tournaments in person. Currently two clubs meet in person, one in Kapaa (contact TheChessHabit) and one in Waimea (contact Glockster64). Another Kauai site on chess.com is a club called Team Kauai, for those who wish to participate in matches with other islands, states, colleges, and countries. Please spread the word and invite other players from Kauai. The active sites on Chess.com for people who wish to play team matches for Hawaii are Hawaii Chess Federation and Team Hawaii . The active site for K-12 school-aged students is HCF Scholastic . Please invite other players from Kauai.
